proposed_cp1_join_D8: CP1 passes PRT a CP1-owned census wrapper instead of the parent callable; the wrapper allows one call, calls the parent-supplied census exactly once, makes a bounded exact-JSON copy of the returned dict, records consumed_sha256 = sha256(_canonical(copy)) and returns that copy, so PRT consumes exactly the hashed bytes

_canonical is textually identical in CP1 v2 (l.264-266), PRT v4 (l.179-181) and CP2 v4 (l.337-339); CP2 v4 served_sha256 = sha256(_canonical(served)) over the exact returned dict (l.744) and is exposed as endedness census.served_sha256 (l.1781)
after PRT RELEASED: wrapper calls == 1 and endedness census.served_sha256 == consumed_sha256 (cause CP1_ENDEDNESS); receipt binds both digests

plus whichever CP2 v5 binding the parent approves: (T) CP1 per-invocation nonce bound one-shot to the log before PRT and passed to evaluate_endedness; or (C) the identical inner census callable and the identical ORIGINAL deadline_check passed to evaluate_endedness

census-specific copy caps sized to PRT's 200000-row limit (the general CP1 node cap of 131072 would refuse hosts above ~21800 processes); above the caps the wrapper raises and PRT holds (P4_CENSUS_FAILED)
